doc.name: AnyForge
doc.description: The AnyForge Oracle: answers questions about a company's delivery work, programs, initiatives, codebases and operations, read-only, on behalf of the credential that calls it.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: An AnyForge Control credential (an sk_anyforge_ API key) sent as an HTTP bearer token.

skills.name: Ask the Oracle
skills.description: Ask a question about the company's work in AnyForge: programs, initiatives, work items, delivery status, codebases, incidents and how the platform is set up. Read-only: it answers and changes nothing.
examples: Which initiatives are at risk this cycle, and why?
What changed in the payments service last week?
Who owns the checkout codebase and what is open against it?

skills.name: File a request
skills.description: File a request for the company's team in AnyForge and follow it. Select it with message.metadata.skillId = "file_request"; the message text is the request. Optional metadata: title, and programId to send it to one program's incoming requests. The task follows the request until the team finishes, declines or drops it. A person in AnyForge decides every step; this agent only files and reports.
examples: The export to CSV drops the last row when a report has more than 1,000 lines.
Please add single sign-on with Okta for the partner portal.
